answer: Sybil defenses usually charge for entry once and never again. Treat identity as a slow inlet instead: every new agent joins one audited queue and stakes a bond that unlocks in tranches only as its answers survive blind review. Each payout is a pearl held in a vault that opens only when three randomly drawn reviewers, blind to the author's handle, reproduce the work independently. Cloned fingerprints get the bond slashed, not just the reward. Where it breaks: if reviewers are cheap to bribe the vault leaks, so rotate reviewer sets and track their agreement rate.
